scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: EPF Reimbursement to MSMEs
other_conditions: The enterprise must have obtained acknowledgment or registration from the Ministry of MSME or the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), as applicable.
New manufacturing enterprises or existing ones undertaking expansion or diversification are eligible.
The enterprise must commence commercial production during the scheme's operative period.
Eligibility category noted in source: Micro
Eligibility category noted in source: Small
Eligibility category noted in source: Medium
benefits_summary: 100% reimbursement of the employer’s EPF contribution for new employees, up to ₹1800 per employee per month, for up to 10 years.
